reasoning_content: fnm installed at /usr/local/fnm/fnm. Let me set up node 20.11.0.

action.command:
export PATH=/usr/local/fnm:$PATH
eval "$(fnm env)"
fnm install 20.11.0 2>&1 | tail -5
fnm default 20.11.0 2>&1
fnm use 20.11.0
node -v; npm -v
# symlink into /usr/local/bin for persistence
ln -sf /usr/local/fnm/fnm /usr/local/bin/fnm 2>/dev/null
ls -la /usr/local/fnm
